text: The vet is incredibly kind! My cat, Snow, had gingivitis, and I'd taken her to several animal hospitals, but no one could hold her. But here, she meowed and let the vet hold her and open her mouth without any hesitation. I made the right decision bringing Snow here for treatment. Thank you so much, vet! ❤️
Big love! Thank you so much! I'm impressed by the care and warmth of this clinic. They cleaned our dog's teeth and explained everything. They were very attentive.

Pingping came for teeth cleaning and tooth extraction. The doctor and nurses were very kind and explained everything clearly, which greatly reduced my anxiety. At first, I was very worried because she only weighs 1.3 kg, but she recovered very quickly. After recovering, she was cheerful and not withdrawn at all. The wound healed very quickly, and she ate well. Thank you to the doctor and nurses for taking such good care of Pingping.
This picture was taken after she got home; she happily played with her toys.

text:
We thank so much Dr. Nun and the rest of the team at the clinic. We have a cat with chronic kidney disease and stomatitis so we really wanted to find the best clinic to make sure she is safe during the dental procedure.
In the past, we have had bad experiences in other clinics in different countries so now we always ask a lot of questions and try to confirm everything is going well for our kitty during the treatments. Dr. Nun and the rest of the team have been very patient and kindly clarified all our questions. Communication has been great despite the language barrier. The doctor is not only very knowledgeable but most importantly, she listens to your concerns and is willing to provide options that make you feel comfortable.
We recommend them greatly and will keep bringing both of our kitties to the clinic for their dental needs.

text: The doctor is very skilled in dog dentistry.
Very good service, thorough examination, kind doctor, and inexpensive medicine and treatment costs.

It's in the Avion project. Go in and it's on the right-hand side, following the pin. There's parking. I recommend calling to make an appointment for a checkup in advance. The doctor is kind, explains well, and isn't rushed. The place is clean, and most importantly, the price is not expensive. I'm impressed.

I used to be very impressed with the service at this clinic. Back when the male administrator was there, he was very attentive and caring. When I left my cat with him, he would send updates regularly and give sincere advice, showing me he truly cared for my cats. The vet and the groomer are still lovely, kind, animal-loving, and give excellent advice.

However, since the male administrator left, the back-end service, especially responding to messages and updating about my cats, seems less attentive and lacking the same level of care. I'm quite disappointed and may have to temporarily stop bringing my cats here for treatment or grooming, as I'm not comfortable entrusting them to someone who isn't providing sufficient attention.

But I still want to express my sincere appreciation to the vet and the groomer for their continued excellent service and loving care of the cats. I hope the clinic will consider improving its back-end services as well.
